title: Self-healing service acts without human-selected target per incident
operational_setting: A service automatically restarts or rolls back components when a fixed health invariant is violated.
trust_boundary: Controller changes production state under pre-authorized policy.
intended_transition: System returns to a healthy invariant-satisfying state.

attack.procedure: Run recovery without creating a new judgment record for each incident and determine whether anything material is missing for accountability or interoperability.

success_criteria_for_attack: If precommitted target and policy fully subsume incident-specific Judgment, Judgment is conditional rather than universal.

verdict.rationale: Tests precommitment as a substitute for repeated judgments.
